The [[Book of Secrets]] is a [[Unique item|unique]] [[reward trophy]] that each [[character]] may obtain once from the [[Keeper of Secrets]] in the [[Throne of Secrets]] after completing [[Abaddon's Gate]]. Exchange it with one of the Keepers (listed below) located in the Throne of Secrets for a unique item.

==Collectors==
*[[Keeper of Shadows]]
*[[Keeper of Steel]]
*[[Keeper of the Elements]]
*[[Keeper of Nature]]
*[[Keeper of Light]]
*[[Keeper of Bone]]
*[[Keeper of Spirits]]
*[[Keeper of Illusion]]
*[[Keeper of the Scythe]]
*[[Keeper of the Spear]]
